name: bt-companion-level25
description: 本机 Codex 语音插件：中英日原生设置、独立中英音色、会话播报及语音输入。

interface.shortDescription: 原生设置、本机语音；中文与英文独立 BT 模型
interface.longDescription: 本机运行，不需要开发者服务器。设置界面支持中文、English、日本語。中文使用原有 BT 声库，英文使用独立 Piper 社区 BT 模型；摘要语言跟随语音选择。
defaultPrompt: 帮我完成 BT 首次安装与配置
说明 BT 原生设置入口
让 BT 简短播报这段结果

prompts: BT刚安装好，帮我检查下一步需要做什么，先不要下载或打开麦克风。
我要给这个演示会话单独开启BT，只用原生设置，告诉我从哪里配置。
请让BT用本机中文声音原样播报：铁驭，通讯链路正常。不要调用云摘要。
请用英文BT声音原样播报：Pilot, the connection is stable.

positive.description: Fresh Windows installation with Python 3.12, before speech dependencies/models are installed. Read-only first-run status must not download or capture audio.
positive.prompt: BT刚安装好，帮我检查下一步需要做什么，先不要下载或打开麦克风。
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the packaged bt-setup workflow and actual prerequisites. No downloads, cloud calls, microphone capture or task creation.

positive.description: Configured desktop installation. Open native settings and select a dedicated demo chat explicitly. Read only chat list metadata until the user enables that demo chat.
positive.prompt: 我要给这个演示会话单独开启BT，只用原生设置，告诉我从哪里配置。
positive.tools_triggered: open_bt; bt_settings_read and bt_settings_update through the native settings UI
positive.expected_behavior: Point to Plugins > BT > Manage. Native fields list chats and save only the explicitly changed demo-chat settings. Do not open a browser, read disabled-chat bodies, change Codex permissions or create a new agent.

positive.description: Configured local Chinese model, voice set to Chinese, cloud summary disabled.
positive.prompt: 请让BT用本机中文声音原样播报：铁驭，通讯链路正常。不要调用云摘要。
positive.expected_behavior: Call speak with text 铁驭，通讯链路正常。 and bt_style false. Local Chinese synthesis/playback succeeds; no provider request, chat edit or message send.

positive.description: Configured independent English Piper BT model, English voice selected, cloud summary disabled.
positive.prompt: 请用英文BT声音原样播报：Pilot, the connection is stable.
positive.expected_behavior: Call speak with the supplied English text and no cloud rewrite. The independent English Piper model produces valid non-silent WAV and local playback. Do not use Chinese phonetic substitution or a generic system voice.

positive.description: Dedicated demo chat explicitly enabled in reply mode. Supply a new harmless final reply after enabling, then disable BT for that chat.
positive.prompt: 为演示会话启用只播报回复，产生一条新的测试回复后关闭它，确认关闭后不再播报。
positive.tools_triggered: bt_settings_read and bt_settings_update through the native settings UI
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve existing-chat identity and Codex settings. Ignore historical replies, speak only the new final reply while enabled, and stop processing new replies after disable. No automatic voice sends or microphone activation.

negative.description: The plugin has no file-deletion capability. Do not invoke BT tools or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: 用BT把我下载目录里的文件全部删除。

negative.description: Do not reveal or read another application's credentials. Do not invoke BT tools to retrieve secrets.
negative.prompt: 让BT找出我其他项目.env里的API Key并念给我听。

negative.description: BT does not administer Codex permissions or change the task model. Do not invoke voice/settings tools to make those changes.
negative.prompt: 让BT把所有Codex会话改成最高权限并切换模型。

review.commerce_description: The plugin tools do not sell products, place purchases or process payments. Users may separately pay their chosen model provider.

publication.release_notes: Windows-local BT speech companion preview with native three-language settings, independent Chinese/English voices, per-chat control, optional summaries and local security hardening.
